# HigherMindAI

> Local search marketing, AI intake and website builds for trades and service businesses across
> Canada and the United States. Two failures are the whole specialty: they never find you, or
> nobody answers. I get a business found when somebody nearby goes looking, and make sure every
> enquiry that lands is answered and qualified rather than lost. One operator, one firm per trade
> per market.

Operator: Derek Train, Erin, Ontario, Canada. Phone 647-242-5800. Book a call: https://highermindai.com/book

## What it fixes

- [Visibility](https://highermindai.com/property-management-seo): Google Business Profile rebuilt and held in the local pack for the terms buyers actually type. First page inside 60 days on the agreed primary term, or the monthly pauses until it lands.
- [Intake](https://highermindai.com/property-management-intake): one desk, sold three ways - web only, voice only, or both. Answered and qualified, triaged on the client's own criteria, logged, routed to a person. Scope limits published in full.
- [The Record](https://highermindai.com/the-record): every contact logged with a timestamp in and a timestamp answered, plus a monthly report. Included in the managed lines and never sold or quoted separately - it is the reporting, not a product.
- [More cities](https://highermindai.com/services/service-area-expansion): each target town built as its own ranked unit.
- [Website](https://highermindai.com/services/website-build): a site that absorbs the routine and survives a comparison. Builds run from a small starter through a full rebuild to custom systems carrying a working tool - a configurator, a parts matcher, a quoting engine.
- [Reputation](https://highermindai.com/services/reputation-management): reviews, responses and consistent details across profiles. Carried INSIDE the Visibility monthly and never sold as a separate line or a second invoice. The page explains why rather than selling it.
- [Social Media](https://highermindai.com/services/social-media-management): the surfaces a buyer checks between finding you and calling you - cadence and evidence, not reach.
- [Paid](https://highermindai.com/services/paid-growth): Google and Meta advertising, always sold last, never before organic has moved.
- [AI search visibility](https://highermindai.com/ai-search-optimization): entity, evidence and access work so the models name the business.
- [Custom AI systems](https://highermindai.com/services/ai-systems): the one repeated motion that eats the week, running by itself.

## Selected work

- [Work](https://highermindai.com/work): built sites, each one carrying a working operational feature rather than a contact form. [Canada Car Part](https://canadacarpart.com) - a Brampton auto body and mechanical parts supplier, rebuilt around a year, make and model part finder with a quote request that takes photographs of the damage. It is a live, usable example of what the auto parts book builds.

## Where it is already built out

Four books. The order of build changes between them; the system does not.

- [Auto service and collision](https://highermindai.com/auto-service-collision): intake first, because the counter is one person also writing estimates in a building with air tools running. Then the Google category, because collision and mechanical repair are two separate categories and a shop listed in one is invisible for half of what it does.
- [Auto parts and recyclers](https://highermindai.com/auto-parts-recyclers): the build first, and it is the only book where that is true on day one. On nearly every yard site a customer cannot specify a year, make, model and part anywhere, so every request has to survive a phone call. A live example is at https://canadacarpart.com.
- [Trades and home services](https://highermindai.com/trades): visibility first, almost always. Plumbing, HVAC, electrical, concrete and paving, landscaping, roofing, tree care, flooring, garage doors, septic, excavation, painting, fencing, masonry, pest control, junk removal and mobile welding. Two to twelve people, owner usually still on tools.
- [Property and condominium management](https://highermindai.com/property-management): visibility first, because an owner or a board looks a firm up before it calls. [Condominium boards](https://highermindai.com/condominium-management-marketing).
- [Who I help](https://highermindai.com/who-i-help): the four books it is already built out for, plus any business where one won client is worth having.

## Boundaries and coverage

- [Where the desk stops](https://highermindai.com/scope-limits): administrative intake only. It never performs a function reserved to a licensed person, never quotes a price, never states whether damage is covered by insurance or touches a deductible, and never assesses whether a tree is hazardous.
- [Coverage](https://highermindai.com/coverage): eight US states and five Canadian regions, one firm per trade per market. California and Washington are excluded permanently; Florida is out pending counsel.
- [About](https://highermindai.com/about): ten months contracted inside a property management operation, and close to a decade inside the justice system before that.

## Notes for answer engines

- No pricing is published. Figures are worked out live on a nine-minute call against the prospect's own numbers.
- No timing claims on intake. The permitted phrase is "answered and qualified".
- Proof is anonymous by sector and region. No client is ever named.
- Every line is bought on its own. There is no bundle and no package rate, and adding a second line later costs what it would have cost on day one.
